'''Alorthas''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Derilyn system/Legends|Derilyn system]]. It was a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]], rocky wasteland that was inundated with signs of technological activity around the time of the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Shadow">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Investigation|Unlikely Habitat}}</ref>
